ADDR-001.test_text: The premises were let for residential purposes.

ADDR-002.test_text: The premises are required bona fide by the landlord for occupation as a residence.

ADDR-003.test_text: One qualifying occupation route is occupation by the landlord himself or by a member of his family dependent on him.

ADDR-004.test_text: One qualifying occupation route is occupation by the landlord himself or by a member of his family dependent on him.
ADDR-004.branch_text: Occupation by a member of the landlord family.

ADDR-005.test_text: One qualifying occupation route is occupation by the landlord himself or by a member of his family dependent on him.
ADDR-005.branch_text: That family member is dependent on the landlord.

ADDR-006.test_text: For the landlord-or-dependent-family occupation branch, the landlord is the owner of the premises.

ADDR-007.test_text: An alternative qualifying occupation route is occupation by a person for whose benefit the premises are held.

ADDR-008.test_text: The landlord or such person has no other reasonably suitable residential accommodation.
